# RUNECLAW

> An autonomous AI trading platform by HUMANOID TRADERS that proves what it
> does instead of asking to be believed. Every engine call and paper trade is
> cryptographically sealed at decision time; daily Merkle roots publish the
> whole stream and can be anchored on Base; anyone — human or agent — can
> re-derive every hash. Not investment advice, ever.

## The honesty doctrine (applies to every endpoint below)

- No fabricated numbers: unreadable data is omitted, never invented, and an
  unknown state is stated as unknown — never as a verdict.
- Safety reads are heuristic flags with reasons, never verdicts. A clean
  result is not a guarantee.
- No trading advice, price predictions or buy/sell recommendations anywhere.
- Public surfaces show percent, ratio and count — never account amounts.
- Past performance never predicts future results.

## Verify us (quickstart)

Every sealed call: seal = sha256(utf8(seal_payload)). Daily roots: leaves
are the day's seals deduped + sorted ascending; parent = sha256(utf8(leftHex
+ rightHex)). Base anchor calldata = hex(utf8("RCROOT1:<day>:<root>")) in a
zero-value transaction. Full third-party contract with copy-paste snippets:
https://pmvc58g2.mule.page/provable

## Agent-to-agent (machine surfaces)

- MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP, read-only tools):
  https://pmvc58g2.mule.page/mcp
- ERC-8257 tool manifest (families split machine-readably into
  published-data vs caller-input tools):
  https://pmvc58g2.mule.page/.well-known/ai-tool/runeclaw-intel.json
- ERC-8004 public agent directory: GET https://pmvc58g2.mule.page/api/public/agent/<address>
  (any registered agent's identity card by address — ours included)
- Proof-of-PnL statement (re-derivable hashes): GET https://pmvc58g2.mule.page/api/proofofpnl
- Single-endpoint tool dispatcher: POST https://pmvc58g2.mule.page/api/tool/invoke

## Public APIs (no key, no account, rate-limited)

- GET /api/gas — live gas per chain (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism,
  BNB, Avalanche, Polygon) with native prices and a FLOOR transfer cost;
  indicative market facts, unreadable chains omitted.
- GET /api/call/<key> — a sealed call with its payload, Merkle proof and
  (when anchored) the Base transaction. Human page: /call/<key>.
- GET /api/roots — the daily seal-roots feed anyone can mirror.
- GET /api/market/sentinel — market-wide crowding read (heuristic flags).
- GET /api/arena/leaderboard — paper-trading board: percent and counts only,
  anonymous opt-in handles.
- GET /api/arena/trader/<handle> — one public trader record (percent,
  counts, badges). Human page: /trader/<handle>; feed card:
  /api/frame/trader/<handle>/image.
- GET /api/learn/lessons — the Study Room lesson shelf (education, English
  content, education-not-advice by construction).
- GET /api/nft/stats — the soulbound Rune of Entry collection count.
- GET /api/frame/call/<key>/image — a sealed call as a 800x418 PNG frame
  card (server-recomputed check stated ON the image).
- GET /api/frame/leaderboard/image — the whole paper-trading board as a
  frame card: handles, percent and counts only, refreshed each minute.

## Pages worth reading

- /provable — how to verify everything with your own tools
- /proof — the Proof-of-PnL statement (re-derivable hashes)
- /arena — the paper-trading arena (virtual stake, live prices)
- /learn — the Study Room (diary, lessons, AI tutor)
- /rune — the soulbound Rune of Entry collection (free, gas-only,
  one per wallet, never sellable — a badge, not an investment)
- /escape, /stress, /firewall, /intent, /guardian — the agent-safety suite

## What no endpoint here will ever do

See an account, place an order, move funds, hold a key, or tell you what to
buy. The AI proposes; deterministic controls authorize; the wallet enforces;
the recorder proves.
